function: Soft MIMO detection: a path selection network builds the tree-search candidate list and a distribution fitting network completes symbol marginals, giving bit LLRs (p. 1).
system: 4x4 MIMO (Nt=Nr=4), OFDM with 48 subcarriers, 16-QAM and 64-QAM with LDPC codes; no RIS; carrier frequency not stated (p. 4).
method: Two fully connected networks (one hidden layer of 8 neurons each, p. 5): path selection net trained with MSE (p. 3), distribution fitting net with cross-entropy, block-wise (p. 4); supervised.
data_channel: Simulated correlated Rayleigh MIMO channel, exponential correlation (coefficients 0.3 at receiver, 0 at transmitter) per [12]; 24000 training samples per SNR point; no public dataset (p. 4, p. 5).
test_conditions: Trained at SNR 24-27 dB (16-QAM) and 33-36 dB (64-QAM), 1 dB steps (p. 5); tested by BER versus SNR in the same setup, no other scenario (p. 5).
baselines: Non-learned: LMMSE, IFSD, MPPS [10], soft-output SD; learned: DetNet, PDN and OAMP-Net2, all deep-unfolding detectors (p. 5).
metrics: BER versus SNR with LDPC coding (Fig. 3, p. 5); runtime in ms on a CPU (Table I, p. 5).
complexity: Count of multiplications Nt(|P|(3Nt+6N1+4M-1)+4N2M) plus 2Nt divisions (p. 4); runtime 0.73 ms versus 18.58 ms for SD, 64-QAM (Table I, p. 5).
openness: none (no code or data link given).
q1_support: p. 4: "where A is a Rayleigh fading channel" - custom correlated model with exponential correlation [12]; no 3GPP channel model or measured data (3GPP [13] is cited only for the LDPC code).
q2_support: p. 5: "The training SNR covers from 24 dB to 27 dB for" 16 QAM - tests are an SNR sweep with 4x4 antennas and one channel model; no unseen antennas, correlation, or channel.
q3_support: p. 5: "IFSD: An improved algorithm [8] of FSD"; p. 5: "DetNet: The network by unfolding the iterative projected" - BER in Fig. 3 against non-learned (LMMSE, IFSD, MPPS, SD) and learned (DetNet, PDN, OAMP-Net2) detectors.
q4_support: p. 4: "the number of floating-point multiplications and divisions) of" the proposed networks; p. 5: "The complexity comparison based on runtime on a standard" CPU, Table I.
q5_support: p. 5: "the training set contains 24000 samples for" each SNR point - simulated data; no code or data link, DOI, or public dataset is given.
notes: Area 1: the networks perform soft MIMO detection (candidate path selection and symbol distribution fitting, output bit LLRs). MPPS [10] is a non-learned statistical method of the same group, so the learned baselines of q3 are the deep-unfolding networks DetNet, PDN and OAMP-Net2 (p. 5). Table I (p. 5) was read from the page image: PDN 0.14, DetNet 0.40, OAMP-Net2 1.43, LMMSE 0.10, IFSD 0.21, MPPS 0.16, PSDFN 0.73, SD 18.58 ms.
